_edit: Auvers room. Guestbook. Leave `formAction` empty and the form composes a pre-filled email — no backend, works today. Paste a Formspree / Web3Forms / FormSubmit endpoint into `formAction` and the same form posts there instead, so messages land in the inbox without the visitor needing a mail app.
title: Something new is starting
lede: Van Gogh's last spring, he painted almond blossom for a newborn nephew. Not an ending. A beginning, in the palest blue he ever mixed.
calmPrompt: Press and hold the sky to calm it
calmedPrompt: There it is. Sign the guestbook.

colophon: Type: Fraunces & Literata. Sky: curl noise and a lot of patience. Palettes after Van Gogh, whose paintings entered the public domain long ago; no painting images are reproduced here.
